config.assumption_status: Pre-outcome sensitivity grid. All Study 2 effects and opportunity rates are assumptions; no participant target is selected.
config.pairing: Generate a balanced N=200 panel, then retain the first 20/24/25 participants in each shuffled cell for N=160/192/200. Common random numbers across N; no optional stopping.
config.effect_status: OR=1.5 main effects and interaction OR=0.67 are inherited illustrative assumptions, with explicit smaller/larger main-effect and null sensitivities.

scenarios.name: v6_round2_smoothed_anchor
scenarios.rationale: Ten fresh complete author-confirmed screened experts; v6 materials. Descriptive sensitivity only, not Study 2 estimates; C-05 has since changed in v7.

scenarios.name: v6_round2_half_correct_ai_opportunities
scenarios.rationale: Half the smoothed first-four opportunity rates; fixed hypothetical sensitivity.

scenarios.name: v6_round2_double_correct_ai_opportunities
scenarios.rationale: Twice the smoothed first-four opportunity rates, capped at .95; fixed hypothetical sensitivity.

scenarios.name: v7_C05_recoverability_50_assumption
scenarios.rationale: Assume .50 correct unaided C-05 recovery after the v7 dual-expiry change; not a validation result.

scenarios.name: v7_C05_recoverability_85_assumption
scenarios.rationale: Assume .85 correct unaided C-05 recovery after the v7 dual-expiry change; not a validation result.

scenarios.name: v6_round2_high_dependence
scenarios.rationale: Same descriptive opportunity vector with stronger participant outcome dependence.

config.supplement_status: Added after the original 15-scenario run and the v6 round-2 audit. These sensitivities do not replace or select the earlier scenarios.

source.smoothing: (count+.5)/11, used only as a finite sensitivity anchor
source.caution: v7 now has an additional C-05 membership-currency failure. Focused v7 expert data and the separate Study 2 technical pilot are still pending.

limitations: All effect and opportunity rates are assumptions, not Study 2 estimates.
Historical expert data and material version are not interchangeable with revised Study 2.
H2 is evaluated by precision and coverage, not rejection power.
No recruitment target or acceptable-precision threshold is selected.
Main-effect rejection rates count failed fits as non-rejections; coverage is conditional on successful fits.
Unobserved profiles trigger an explicitly recorded contrast-reference change, not removal of treatment terms.
Informative opportunity selection is a conditional-estimand sensitivity, not just a sampling-precision scenario.
